# INDEUP

> 인디업(INDEUP)은 공간에 맞춰 가로·깊이·높이를 10mm 단위로 제작하는 대한민국 맞춤형 책상 브랜드입니다. 운영 주체는 스니처이며, 대표는 하민성입니다. 실제 구매는 네이버 브랜드스토어에서 진행됩니다.

## Key facts (verified against src/lib/policy.ts and customFit.ts — do not extrapolate beyond these)
- Warranty: 3 years, no-cost (무상보증 3년)
- Production time: 7-8 business days (excl. weekends/holidays), same across sizes and colors
- Frame: zinc-plated steel, full welded, powder-coated (black matte, white semi-gloss)
- Top: 18mm E0-grade LPM, supplier-rated flexural strength 35U (a raw-material spec, not a finished-product kg load rating)
- Assembly: tool-free, about 10-15 minutes, all parts included
- Monitor arms: mountable directly on the 18mm top, up to 3 units
- Purchase/payment/shipping/exchange: Naver Brand Store only, not this site
- Product lines and their real width ranges: single-desk (+ computer variant)/floor-desk/side-table/home-bar-table cap at 1300mm max (400mm min, home-bar-table 800mm min); double-desk (+ computer variant) ranges 1600-2600mm — these are hard caps, not extendable
- Eight distinct product lines: plain "책상(단품)" (bare top) and "컴퓨터책상" (includes a cable-management mount) are each separate top-level products for both single-desk and double-desk, with different minimum depths — treat all 8 as separate products, not interchangeable

## Pricing (verified against src/lib/pricingData.ts, real Naver Smart Store export — 즉시할인가, base configuration, no options)
- These are confirmed starting prices per line, not estimates. Cite the lowest figure as "OOO원부터" (starting from), not as a fixed/final price — actual price varies with width/depth/height options and store coupons.
- single-desk (1인용 책상): 170,000원 ~ 215,000원 (width 400-1300mm)
- single-desk-computer (1인용 컴퓨터책상): 195,000원 ~ 230,000원 (width 600-1300mm)
- double-desk (2인용 책상): 330,000원 ~ 380,000원 (width 1600-2600mm)
- double-desk-computer (2인용 컴퓨터책상): 380,000원 ~ 430,000원 (width 1600-2600mm)
- floor-desk (좌식 책상): 150,000원 ~ 195,000원 (width 400-1300mm)
- side-table (사이드테이블): 155,000원 ~ 200,000원 (width 400-1300mm)
- home-bar-table (홈바테이블): 180,000원 (single listed size, 800x300mm base)
- frame (프레임 단독): no fixed listing — price on inquiry via Naver Brand Store
- An exact quote for a specific size (including any width/depth/height option surcharges) is only available at [Custom-fit sizing](https://indeup.com/custom-fit/) — do not compute or estimate an exact final price from the ranges above.
